test.create_query: CREATE TABLE tab ( id UInt64, message String, INDEX idx(message) TYPE text(tokenizer = 'splitByNonAlpha') ) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY id
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO tab SELECT number, if(number % 10000 = 0, concat('payment ', toString(number), ' charged twice for user ', toString(number % 997)), concat('request ', toString(number), ' served in ', toString(number % 1000), ' ms for user ', toString(number % 997), ' status ok')) FROM numbers(3000000)
test.query: SELECT count() FROM tab WHERE hasAnyTokenPrefix(message, 'charg')
SELECT count() FROM tab WHERE arrayExists(t -> startsWith(t, 'charg'), tokens(message))
SELECT count() FROM tab WHERE hasAnyTokenPrefix(message, ['charg', 'refund'])
SELECT count() FROM tab WHERE arrayExists(t -> startsWith(t, 'charg') OR startsWith(t, 'refund'), tokens(message))
SELECT count() FROM tab WHERE hasAnyTokenLike(message, 'ch%ed')
SELECT count() FROM tab WHERE arrayExists(t -> like(t, 'ch%ed'), tokens(message))
SELECT count() FROM tab WHERE hasAllTokenLike(message, ['charg%', 'twice'])
SELECT count() FROM tab WHERE arrayExists(t -> like(t, 'charg%'), tokens(message)) AND arrayExists(t -> like(t, 'twice'), tokens(message))
SELECT count() FROM tab WHERE hasAllTokenLike(message, ['user', 'charg%'])
SELECT count() FROM tab WHERE hasAnyTokenLike(message, 'user') AND hasAnyTokenLike(message, 'charg%')
SELECT count() FROM tab WHERE hasAnyTokenRegexp(message, '^charg(ed|ing)$')
SELECT count() FROM tab WHERE arrayExists(t -> match(t, '^charg(ed|ing)$'), tokens(message))
SELECT count() FROM tab WHERE hasAnyTokenRegexp(message, '^[a-c][a-z]+ed$')
SELECT count() FROM tab WHERE arrayExists(t -> match(t, '^[a-c][a-z]+ed$'), tokens(message))
